all_methods: GET only — read-only API, no write/delete endpoints
shape_note: PokeAPI is a flat resource graph, not a strict parent/child hierarchy — every resource has a list endpoint (paged, filterable by limit/offset) and a detail endpoint (by numeric id OR by name string, both accepted at the same {id} path param). Detail responses cross-reference other resources via NamedAPIResource objects ({name, url}) rather than nesting — e.g. a pokemon response links out to its species, moves, abilities, types; pokemon-species links to its evolution-chain. The OpenAPI spec itself does not carry response body schemas (responses are typed as opaque text/plain), so field shapes need to come from a live sample call per resource during Phase 6.
